currentSemantics.entryCondition: A row becomes diagnostics.nearMisses only when its FIRST Formal rejection reason is exactly A/B setup not formed.
currentSemantics.prerequisiteMeaning: It has already survived every earlier ordered gate through sector admission.
currentSemantics.missingCount: min(number of failed A checks, number of failed B checks)
currentSemantics.diagnosticTruncation: global sort by missingCount asc, nearScore desc, then slice first 12 BEFORE Shadow archive receives symbols
currentSemantics.archiveTruncation: archive then sorts those surviving near symbols and keeps at most 6 per price pool

algebraicFinding.identity: Because both A and B have exactly 6 checks, nearScore = 6 - missingCount.
algebraicFinding.consequence: The second sort key nearScore is mathematically redundant with missingCount and cannot break ties.

fixedSyntheticWitnesses.conclusion: A 0.01 miss and 1.20 miss are identical under current near-miss ranking.

fixedSyntheticWitnesses.setup: Suppose >=12 GENERAL setup-first-fail rows appear before equally-ranked THOUSAND rows in stable input order.
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.consequence: diagnostics.nearMisses.slice(0,12) can remove all THOUSAND near misses before the archive's per-pool byPool(near,6) logic ever sees them.
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.conclusion: The later per-pool cap does not repair the earlier global truncation.

fixedSyntheticWitnesses.candidateA: A is 1 failed check away while B fails 6
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.candidateB: B is 1 failed check away while A fails 6
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.conclusion: Ranking does not distinguish which strategy channel is actually near.

interpretationGuard: Current NEAR_MISS is not 'all stocks close to Formal selection'. It is a bounded subset of setup-first-failure rows after all earlier gates.
NEAR_MISS performance cannot be generalized to liquidity, valuation, sector, RR or signal-grade near failures.
missingCount is a Hamming-distance count over heterogeneous checks, not an economic or geometric distance to threshold.
nearScore must not be treated as an independent quality score because it is an affine transform of missingCount.
Absence of a price-pool/channel from NEAR_MISS may reflect global top-12 truncation rather than no near setups.

preferredResearchRepair.firstStep: Keep current Formal and current cohort immutable; add full per-date setup-first-failure counts by price pool and nearest channel before outcome analysis.
requiredFields: raw threshold margins: pullback lower/upper distance, support distance margin, A volume margins, structure margin, trend margins where continuous
B breakoutPctOverThreshold, B volumeMarginTo1_3, closePositionMarginTo0_65, upperShadowMarginTo0_35, ret20MarginTo30
preferredResearchRepair.rankingForResearchSample: If storage must be bounded, stratify by pool × nearestChannel × failed-check-pattern first; only then use deterministic hashing. Do not rank by outcome or a tuned composite distance.
preferredResearchRepair.distanceUse: Continuous margins are descriptive until normalization is preregistered. Do not collapse heterogeneous margins into one score before evidence.

falsification: If existing bounded NEAR_MISS already achieves stable pool/channel/check-pattern coverage on prospective dates, cohort repair may be practically low value.
If outcomes do not differ between one-check near rows and farther multi-check setup rejects after same-date controls, 'near' may be a weak research concept.
If continuous margin adds no information beyond failed-check pattern, reject a distance score rather than tune it.
Do not relax A/B thresholds based on NEAR_MISS returns until cohort coverage and distance semantics are repaired.

governance.researchReceipt: Potential Class A if computed from already-loaded strategySetupState/debug data, isolated Shadow output, zero new market calls and no Formal effect.
governance.thresholdChange: Class C owner approval after prospective OOS evidence.
